/til Write up today's real setup (retry on resilient routing): wiring this repo's GitHub Agentic Workflows (github/gh-aw) to NVIDIA's free hosted NIM endpoints (integrate.api.nvidia.com, nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b, 40 RPM free) via the Copilot BYOK engine mode. Three real failures hit before a green run, in order: (1) AWF proxy rejected every request with 400 'Model has no AI credits pricing' — fixed with frontmatter models.default-ai-credits-pricing input/output 0.000001 (compiler rejects literal 0); (2) proxy token steering silently rewrote the model to claude-sonnet-5 — fixed with sandbox.agent.token-steering: false and model-fallback: false; (3) the agentics sample's timeout-minutes: 15 killed a successful 16.3-minute research session — raised to 30. Additional facts: NIM serves /v1/chat/completions but 404s /v1/responses and /v1/messages (verified with curl), so copilot engine's default completions wire API is the only fit; the threat-detection step needed the larger free nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b to emit the strict THREAT_DETECTION_RESULT JSON; and sustained sessions can hit free-tier 403 throttling, solved by routing through OpenRouter with the NVIDIA BYOK integration (NVIDIA quota first, automatic fallback). Diagnosis workhorse: gh aw audit (run-id). Primary sources: https://github.github.com/gh-aw/ , https://github.com/githubnext/agentics , (build.nvidia.com/redacted)
